observation_vs_hypothesis_boundary.hypothesis: A possible explanation for observations; not a physical fault finding.
observation_vs_hypothesis_boundary.observation: Directly supported by telemetry or detector evidence.

rules.description: Stop causal hypothesis generation when no active detector produced applicable evidence.
rules.recommended_verification_step: Re-run analysis with the required feature set or inspect upstream feature extraction before RCA.

applicability_conditions: at least one active detector applicable
rules.description: Do not generate RCA hypotheses when active detectors report no anomaly evidence.
rules.recommended_verification_step: Treat as no detector anomaly evidence, not as verified healthy ground truth.

applicability_conditions: contextual detector execution status is ok
contradicting_evidence: isolation_forest negative or unavailable for the same representative window
rules.description: Generate an electrical-supply variation hypothesis from contextual battery-voltage deviation.
rules.recommended_verification_step: Measure battery/charging voltage externally and record electrical load state during a repeat capture.

applicability_conditions: isolation forest execution status is ok
isolation forest anomaly flag is true
contradicting_evidence: contextual_battery_voltage negative for an electrical-specific explanation
rules.description: Generate a broad multivariate-pattern hypothesis from Isolation Forest anomaly evidence.
rules.recommended_verification_step: Review the listed feature families and operating context against raw telemetry and operator notes.

applicability_conditions: IF unusual feature list includes rpm or tps
rules.description: Generate a throttle/operating-state hypothesis when IF evidence highlights RPM or TPS features.
rules.recommended_verification_step: Compare RPM/TPS timing with operator input and route/load notes; do not infer RPM solely from TPS.

rules.applicability_conditions: IF unusual feature list contains constant_signal
contradicting_evidence: stable operation notes or external corroboration, when available
rules.description: Generate a possible acquisition/data-quality hypothesis for IF events involving constant-signal features.
rules.recommended_verification_step: Inspect raw frames for dropouts, repeated values, sensor saturation, or intentional stable operation.

rules.description: Preserve detector disagreement without forcing a shared diagnosis.
rules.recommended_verification_step: Review each detector's phenomenon separately; do not merge scores or infer consensus.
